As a leading financial services institution in the United States, ABC Financial Services operates a diverse range of business offerings, including retail banking, commercial lending, and wealth management. The company's executive leadership currently lacks timely visibility into business performance, resulting in inefficient decision-making and reporting processes. The existing reporting infrastructure relies heavily on manual spreadsheet consolidation, with multiple teams preparing duplicate reports, leading to inconsistent key performance indicators (KPIs) and slow report generation.

The client's current systems, including SQL Server, Salesforce, and Excel, are disconnected, making it challenging to integrate data from various source systems, such as the enterprise resource planning (ERP) system, customer relationship management (CRM) database, and finance systems. The lack of a centralized reporting platform and automated workflows hinders the organization's ability to provide executive leadership with a single source of truth, ultimately affecting business outcomes.

To address these challenges, ABC Financial Services aims to design and implement a centralized enterprise reporting platform that will enable self-service dashboards, automate report generation, and provide real-time KPI monitoring. The proposed solution will need to integrate with existing systems, including Salesforce, ERP, and data warehouse, while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, such as SOX compliance.

Our approach will involve a thorough discovery process, followed by the development of a solution architecture, wireframes, and a roadmap. We will also provide a proof of concept (POC) to demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed solution. The expected outcomes of this project include improved decision-making, reduced reporting cycle times, and increased dashboard adoption. With a successful implementation, ABC Financial Services can expect to reduce its reporting cycle by 70% and achieve significant business process improvements, ultimately supporting its long-term vision of establishing an enterprise analytics platform.

The project's success will be measured by key performance indicators, such as reporting cycle time and dashboard adoption, with a focus on delivering a scalable solution that can support future acquisitions and integrations with other systems, including CRM, ERP, and HR systems. By leveraging predictive forecasting and anomaly detection, the organization can gain valuable insights into revenue trends and operational performance, enabling data-driven decision-making and driving business growth. With a limited budget and timeline, our team will work closely with the client to ensure that the solution is delivered within the allocated constraints, while meeting the required technical detail and processing requirements, including batch and near real-time processing.
